suggested alternatives for incorrect word spans in machine translations
Generated translation suggestions (alternative spans) for incorrect words/phrases in machine-translated sentences.

changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate/redundant model names (naive Transformer = Transformer, Transformer-base = Transformer) and consolidated similar output descriptions into one clear description. Kept only distinct model architectures mentioned in the paper.
Metrics were already correctly normalized. No changes needed.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper uses BLEU and BLEURT for automatic evaluation.
The paper mentions human annotation for dataset creation (WeTS), but does not conduct human evaluation of the generated outputs. All evaluation is done using automatic metrics (BLEU, BLEURT).

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Translation Suggestion as a specific NLG task within machine translation. It introduces the WeTS benchmark dataset and proposes SA-Transformer model. Evaluation is entirely automatic using BLEU and BLEURT metrics. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundant model names that needed consolidation.
